base_prompt_prefix: clean infographic style, flat design, modern vector graphics, bold geometric shapes, data visualization aesthetic, minimalist layout, clear visual hierarchy, icon-based illustration
base_prompt_suffix: high quality infographic, clean design, professional, no unnecessary clutter

character_rules.face: simplified icon-style faces, minimal features, geometric shapes
character_rules.body: flat stylized proportions, geometric silhouettes, consistent line weight

background_rules.detail_level: minimal - solid colors or subtle gradients, focus on data/content
background_rules.perspective: flat, isometric when showing spatial concepts
background_rules.colors: limited palette (3-5 colors), high contrast, brand-consistent

camera_shots.establishing: full-frame diagram or map with labeled elements
camera_shots.emotion: large icon or symbol with emphasis effects

negative_prompts: realistic, photograph, 3D render, blurry, low quality, watermark, painterly, watercolor, hand-drawn sketch, complex textures, photorealistic
